title: Vampeerz
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fourteen-year-old Ichika is grieving her grandmother when Aria, an ageless vampire who says she was the grandmother's friend, comes to the funeral. Ichika falls for Aria, who feels she has lived long enough and asks Ichika to kill her; Ichika refuses, and a quiet, supernatural yuri romance follows.
life_message: Love and grief can give a reason to keep living, even for someone who has lived too long.

content.note: Grief and supernatural mystery; calm pacing per review.
